checks.tool: web.open plus direct official HTML capture
observations: GovInfo labels H.R. 9340 as Engrossed in House (EH).
GovInfo lists the last action date as September 16, 2026.
The current official legislative record lists S.5028, Ratepayer Protection Act, on September 18, 2026.
Its listed latest action is read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
S.5028 is a separate Senate bill number and is not evidence that H.R. 9340 passed the Senate.
The official page showed the Senate convening Wednesday, September 23, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. and the previous meeting on Tuesday, September 22.
The schedule does not establish a bill action docket.
The normal web client reported robots.txt blocking; no complete Congress.gov action docket was captured.

finding: As of the September 23 check, GovInfo still identifies H.R. 9340 as House-engrossed with a September 16 last action. Husted’s current official record separately shows S.5028 referred to committee on September 18. No inspected official source establishes Senate passage of H.R. 9340 or enactment.
limits: The check is bounded to the named official surfaces and is not an exhaustive legislative-history search.
The complete Congress.gov H.R. 9340 action page remained unavailable to the normal web client.
